title: Intent
description: The canonical query-understanding object — docs/API_CONTRACT.md §7.1 (shape reproduced in `fixtures/intent/01_valid_api_example.json`), produced by `POST /ai/v1/query/understand` (API_CONTRACT §7) by the `user_intent` agent (AGENT_CONTRACT.md §1: 「may not invent location/budget/party_size」). Governing rule is spec §8: 「必须允许不确定字段。不要强行猜测。」 — every uncertain field is present-but-null, so all of `category`, `location`, `time`, `budget`, `party_size`, `urgency` are REQUIRED keys whose value may be null. Nothing carries a JSON Schema `default`: a default is a guess.

raw_query.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `raw_query` — the verbatim user text, kept so copy can echo the user's own words (AGENT_CONTRACT §12).

category.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 comment: 「null when not stated」. V1 `categories.slug`.

location.description: Null means the user said nothing about place — the agent asks (spec §8) instead of using the tenant's default district.

budget.description: Never seeded with the tenant average (AGENT_CONTRACT §1 `user_intent`).

party_size.description: `null` in the §7.1 example, and that is the correct answer: asking beats guessing (spec §8).

preferences.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `preferences` — soft terms only. `[]` = none extracted (rule `intent_unknowns_are_unsettled` treats `[]` as unset).

constraints.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `constraints` — hard filters (「不吃辣」 appends `{key:'cuisine_avoid', value:'spicy'}`).

sort_preference.description: `relevance` is the neutral option (API_CONTRACT §7.1) rather than a guess about the user; null means the merger has not chosen yet.

language.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `language`. The answer must be written in this locale (AGENT_CONTRACT §12), so it is never inferred from the UI chrome alone; null falls back to the tenant default at render time.

unknowns.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `unknowns` (spec §8 「只问一个追问」). Invariant: a name listed here must be null / absent / empty in the same object — rule `intent_unknowns_are_unsettled`.

clarification_asked.description: spec §8 allows exactly one follow-up, so the flag must be recorded.

provider.description: `mock` must be visible as such (DECISIONS D4).

IntentKind.title: IntentKind
IntentKind.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `intent` (spec §8 「识别意图」). `unknown` is a first-class answer — it routes to a clarifying question, not to a generic result page.

LocationRefType.title: LocationRefType
LocationRefType.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `location.type`; HK conventions (district / area / MTR station — spec §112).

TimeRefType.title: TimeRefType
TimeRefType.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `time.type`. `open_now` triggers the live-hours computation (AGENT_CONTRACT §5, TTL 24h for hours but 0 for availability).

BudgetUnit.title: BudgetUnit
BudgetUnit.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `budget.per` (`"per":"party"`). V1 `offerings.price_model` uses `per_person`/`hourly`, so the bound's unit must be carried explicitly.

SortPreference.title: SortPreference
SortPreference.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `sort_preference`; 「近一点」 rewrites it to `distance` (same section). Backs `RANKING_FACTOR` weights in AGENT_CONTRACT §6.

UrgencyLevel.title: UrgencyLevel
UrgencyLevel.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 shows `"urgency": "normal"` without enumerating the domain; closed as `low|normal|high` (CONTRACT NOTES 4 in `src/enums.ts`).

UnknownField.title: IntentUnknownField
UnknownField.description: Field names an extractor may declare unknown — `IntentUnknownField` in `src/intent.ts`. `raw_query`, `confidence` and `unknowns` themselves are never unknown.

LocationRef.title: LocationRef
LocationRef.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `location` = `{type:'district', value:'Sha Tin', resolved:{lat,lng}, radius_m:null}`. `radius_m: null` means 「user never said」, not 「unbounded」.

raw.description: The user's own phrase (「周六晚上」), kept for echo-back copy (AGENT_CONTRACT §12).

timezone.description: IANA zone the phrase was interpreted in — V1 `tenants.timezone` default `Asia/Hong_Kong` (AGENT_CONTRACT §12).

BudgetRef.title: BudgetRef
BudgetRef.description: API_CONTRACT §7.1 `budget` = `{min:null, max:500, currency:'HKD', per:'party'}`. 「太贵了」 merges as `budget.max *= 0.7` (`BUDGET_RELAX_FACTOR` in `src/intent.ts`).
